title: Introduce TF module 'gpu-lease-bridge' and IAM 'gpu-semaphore' for Private deploy state handoff
author: Arjun Patel
release_notes: Adds a new tf module to safely migrate and coordinate GPU lease state across tfstate boundaries; introduces a least-privilege IAM semaphore role for cross-account/tenant lease handoffs; includes an idempotent migration helper script and upgrade docs.
description: Motivation: Private installs have multiple tfstate boundaries (tenant vs network vs cluster) which make GPU lease handoffs and ephemeral pool lifecycle awkward during upgrades. This PR introduces a small, focused Terraform module called gpu-lease-bridge plus a companion IAM role (gpu-semaphore) and supporting network claim labels to provide an explicit, auditable handoff primitive between state shards. Goals: 1) provide a safe migration path for existing tenants that keeps existing nodepools usable during cutover, 2) add minimal new IAM surface with clear least-privilege policy for the handoff flow, 3) make the migration idempotent and reversible so on-prem customers can roll back without resource churn. What's included: - modules/gpu-lease-bridge: new module that creates a small 'lease' resource (terraform-managed lock object in a shared remote state bucket) plus bindings to tenant nodepool attachments. The module is intentionally lightweight and intended to be referenced by private-installer overlays. - iam/gpu-semaphore.tf: role and policy that allows tokenized short-lived Acquire/Release operations; scoped to a single tenant/project and constrained by condition metadata. - modules/network/subnet-claim-addons.tf: label + tag helpers so subnet claim controllers can atomically advertise availability to the lease-bridge. - scripts/tfstate_migrate_bridge.sh: idempotent helper that creates a bridge lease, migrates minimal attachments and releases the old claimant; safe to re-run. - docs/upgrade/lease-bridge.md: step-by-step operator guide and rollback checklist. Checklist: - [x] design doc and linear tickets linked (ENG-8742) - [x] unit tests for IAM policy generation - [x] integration test that exercises acquire/release simulation in CI - [x] migration helper script with dry-run mode - [x] docs and example overlay in examples/private/lease-bridge-upgrade.md Related: complements private-installer work on tenant-lease-indexing and tfstate anchoring. NOTE: this PR purposefully avoids changing nodepool labels or eviction policies; those follow-up changes are in a separate RFC/PR.

patch_summary: New module + IAM role + helper script + docs and tests. No modifications to existing nodepool modules; changes are additive and behind a feature flag for private installs.
review_comments: Carmen Li: Please ensure the IAM policy denies any broad iam:PassRole - otherwise it might be used to escalate. Consider adding a condition on resource tags.
Author (Arjun): Good catch; added explicit iam:PassRole denial and condition on tag 'lease-bridge=true' in gpu-semaphore policy.

Omar Navarro: The migration script looked non-idempotent on first pass (mv + delete). Rewrote to use state-aware plan/apply and added dry-run; CI flagged a transient AWS permission error which I re-ran and it passed.

Sofia Bennett: Can we add an observability metric when Acquire/Release happens so Console can show lease transitions? Author: added a lightweight metric emitter to the script and test stubbed metric in integration harness.
Carmen Li: Approving after the policy change and test green.
ci_logs_summary: Initial CI run failed (integration transient IAM permission), fixes pushed in commit i0j1k2, subsequent CI run passed all checks: fmt, validate, unit, integration (simulated acquire/release).
migration_plan: steps: 1) vendor the module into private-installer overlay 2) run tfstate_migrate_bridge.sh --dry-run for each tenant 3) review plan output and metrics 4) run without dry-run to create bridge leases and update attachments 5) monitor acquire/release metrics and Console route 6) roll back by running script --revert if unexpected behavior.
operational_impact: Low-risk additive change. Adds a small cross-tenant state object and an IAM role. No immediate impact until operator applies the module during an upgrade. Rollback path included.
changelog_entry: Add gpu-lease-bridge TF module and gpu-semaphore IAM role to enable coordinated GPU lease handoffs across tfstate boundaries for Private deployments. Include migration helper and docs.
notes_for_support: Support: if customers report stuck leases after cutover, steps: 1) validate bridge lease exists in shared state 2) run tfstate_migrate_bridge.sh --diagnose to collect logs 3) use --revert to return attachments to previous claimant. Attach script output and relevant tfstate snapshots when opening a ticket.
security_considerations: IAM role is least-privilege and limited by resource-tag conditions. The migration script uses short-lived tokens and logs operations to tenant audit logs. We reviewed policies with Security and added an explicit deny for iam:PassRole where unnecessary.
qa_notes: Integration test simulates concurrent Acquire requests; asserts single-winner semantics. Added CI flakiness guard to retry transient cloud API errors. Manual QA run documented in docs/upgrade/lease-bridge.md.
